test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f7f3b84f646a461f42f65e3b1d9eadcd164f98506fe59a654ad86f2a3d86b91.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

**The trapezium moves 90 degree in anti-clockwise direction and after every two steps changed their places.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38b98eb9ace4f59adaec3a312b655d96dceca7539260278014c8f3e55279f52f.png] 

**The circles **move 90 degree in clockwise direction and change its places alternatively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ca355380fe341df16f4b70ddc6559ae75c26aad26ec4a6f717cddc23707a020.png] 

Next step: 

**The trapezium ****will be at the bottom left corner with its base towards the side of the square.**

**The circle will be at the center with the shaded part in the upper right half.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb51b0bb8be07a1d7778bc7002b7e351605c316638207b74b748a04c493f2415.png] 

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb51b0bb8be07a1d7778bc7002b7e351605c316638207b74b748a04c493f2415.png] The pattern is correct. 

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66c36d46365189340e3cd540c553315f91a13a06f8764d475b4ab661b79a57f9.png] The trapezium is positioned incorrectly.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f368ad0106c96dd4f13d36b0d235cd8e8fe29bd981f9e900f7fa4ee6490986ed.png] The shaded part in the circle is incorrect.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11791d9afb79d031c143face0872acaa0f80c01f616c860e9c059101bf988d5b.png] The shaded part in the circle is incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
